capabilities: Navigate and inline-edit journal notes per period type
Run hierarchical periodic reviews in a multi-column layout
Create missing or future periodic notes from Templater templates
Mark reviews as done with cascading to child notes
Bulk-create missing current-period notes via commands
extras: README states conflicting minimum Obsidian versions (v1.9.0 for Bases in Prerequisites, v1.13.0 in Installation); on older versions the plugin will not load. Docs also point to an overview video, a newsletter, and a YouTube channel for more information.
intentEvidence: Navigate and manage your journal and periodic reviews with purpose-built Base views.
motivation: The author wants to codify and ease the labor-intensive periodic review process (daily to weekly to monthly to yearly) with dedicated views.
problem: Journaling with periodic reviews means hopping between many dated notes and manually synthesizing insights up the daily-weekly-monthly-quarterly-yearly hierarchy.

relations.evidence: Periodic Notes plugin sync: Automatically syncs settings when Periodic Notes plugin is enabled
Template support: Uses Templater for template-based note creation
Life Tracker integration: Provides daily notes for Life Tracker commands (works in both views)
multi-column layout (inspired by Andy Matuschak's sliding panes)

summary: Custom Bases views for journaling: navigate daily-to-yearly notes and run hierarchical periodic reviews in a multi-column layout.
